θήρ: a wild beast, beast of prey
θηητήρ: one who gazes at, an admirer
κλιμακτήρ: rung of a ladder; a critical moment in life, danger
λωβητήρ: one who treats despitefully, a foul slanderer
μαστήρ: a seeker, searcher, one who looks for
μασχαλιστήρ: a broad strap passing round the horse
παυστήρ: one who stops, calms, a reliever
προασπιστήρ: one who holds a shield before, champion
τριπτήρ: the vat into which the oil runs when pressed out
τροπωτήρ: twisted leathern thong, with which the oar was fastened
φωστήρ: that which gives light, an illuminator
ἀγχιστήρ: one who brings near, the immediate author
ἐλατήρ: a driver; a broad, flat cake
ἐπαμβατήρ: one who mounts upon, an assailant
ἱκέτης: one who comes to seek protection, a suppliant
ὀξύχειρ: quick with the hands, quick to strike
ὁμοκλητήρ: one who calls out to, an upbraider, threatener
